basis: The November 2, 2022 release is the earliest qualifying communication I could verify. Q3 consolidated GAAP net revenue was $160,233,000, down 9.36% from $176,776,000 a year earlier and below the $167,937,200 threshold. The August guidance allowed revenue above the threshold. The earliest date remains unverified because I could confirm the CFO’s August 31 public conference appearance but could not verify his full remarks.

coverage.detail: April 28 Q1 release. The $190 million ± $5 million revenue forecast applied to Q2 2022.
April 28 earnings call, page 5. Asked about later quarters, the CEO said management would need to see Q2 distributor sell-through to assess Q3 and Q4. He gave no Q3 revenue ceiling.
August 4 Q2 release. The explicit Q3 forecast of $165 million ± 5% spanned $156,750,000 to $173,250,000. Its high end exceeded the threshold by $5,312,800.

The August 26 issuer notice scheduled CFO Sandeep Nayyar’s public Deutsche Bank webcast for August 31 at 4:30 p.m. Pacific. The available transcript excerpt confirms he participated and was asked about channel inventory. It does not establish whether he narrowed the Q3 range during the full discussion.
The issuer’s agenda dates the public Analyst Day to September 8 and identifies the CFO’s financial presentation and management Q&A. The transcript header bears September 9.

Analyst Day Q&A, page 39. Asked what had changed since earnings, the CFO said nothing material had changed and referred back to the $165 million range. His expectation of a sequential decline concerned Q4. He gave no lower Q3 ceiling.
The October 28 Form 8-K reported director Jennifer Lloyd’s resignation under Item 5.02. It contained no sales update.

November 2 actuals. The consolidated income statement reports net revenue in thousands of $160,233 and $176,776 for the three months ended September 30, 2022 and 2021, respectively. The separate $125 million ± $5 million outlook applied to Q4.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s IR release is dated November 2, 2022. Its SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same November 2 Business Wire dateline and identifies September 30 as the quarter end. This verifies the public date of the actuals. The unresolved August 31 remarks prevent certifying November 2 as the first qualifying disclosure.
